title: Lite loop manifest
description: The minimal contract that makes an existing cron loop provable: one archetype, one goal metric, one receipt per tick, a durable ledger, and a progress budget or a health SLO. A receipt may carry invalidates_effects ([{run, ref}]) so a later row drops those effects from counting, matched on loop+run+ref, without rewriting the historical row. A row that carries invalidates_effects is a correction, not a health sample. Roles, identities, and the full ecosystem.json planes stay optional.

loop.description: Stable loop id; matches the "loop" field of every LOOP_RECEIPT it emits.

host.description: Human host name running this loop (e.g. the hostctl-config hosts/ entry). Manifests in a shared registry are per-host.

archetype.description: optimize = hill-climb against a scalar objective; maintain = drain a work queue; observe_propose = sensors turn signals into proposals, never code.

goal_metric.description: The measurable goal this loop claims to move — not the work it does. Receipt effects must reference it.

authority.description: Highest-privilege action the loop may take without a fresh human approval.

ledger.description: Durable receipts JSONL. Never on an ephemeral scratch volume.

effect_probe.description: How the loop re-measures goal_metric after a change ships (command, query, or doc pointer). Empty string when not yet defined.

finisher.description: The stage that closes a work item (merge, resolve, supersede, or an explicit escalation). Empty string when not yet defined.

progress_budget_seconds.description: How long the loop may go without a receipt with outcome acted|measured and nonempty effects before it is stalled. Null only when health is set; a health SLO replaces this budget for stall.

health.description: Optional SLO for watch/monitor loops. When set, stalled means the latest receipt missed the threshold, is infra_error, lacks metrics[metric], or is older than max_age_seconds. A fresh passing measurement is not stalled, even with empty effects. A failing or missing sample must not read healthy.

metric.description: Name of the number the receipt reports under metrics.

op.description: Comparison of metrics[metric] against threshold. Healthy when the comparison holds.

threshold.description: Finite number. NaN and infinities are rejected by the runner.

max_age_seconds.description: A measurement older than this is stale and therefore stalled, the same as a missing sample.

stop_rule.description: The condition under which the loop stops itself or asks a human to retire it. A loop without a stop rule never earns autonomy.

requires.description: Binaries that must be on PATH for the tick to run. The runner fails loudly (exit 6) instead of letting the loop silently no-op.

command.description: Optional default tick command so `loop tick <manifest>` works without `--`.

cron.description: Advisory back-pointer to the cron/launchd schedule that drives this loop (job id or expression). Not interpreted by the runner.
